decisions.reason: The typography consistency rules do not change photo selection, sourcing, placement, or framing.
The source establishes section-level font consistency but does not change the Blue Mesa brand identity or its specified logo and color elements.
Typography consistency is an independent design constraint and does not change the requirement to lay out the complete document.
The font rules do not change whether or how the organization chart must be included.
Typography consistency does not alter Canva editing access, ownership, or the free-assets policy.
The instruction applies typography within sections and does not alter their fixed order.
Font consistency and sizing do not change the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the saved PDF.
The source does not revise the 34-page maximum or establish a necessary change to page-limit compliance.
The typography rule does not change the requirement to integrate the supplied tables and budget sheet.
The source governs typography within appropriate sections but does not change which RFQ content must be included.
The source concerns typography in the current RFQ and does not resume or modify the deferred future modular-template requirement.
Typography consistency does not change the PDF format, count, email-submission method, or export requirements.
